## ctxloom command delete

Delete a command

### Synopsis

Delete a command from a bundle.

Reference format: bundle#commands/name

Examples:
  ctxloom command delete my-bundle#commands/old-command

```
ctxloom command delete <bundle>#commands/<name> [flags]
```
